detail.body:
## Overview On SM12x (RTX 50 series, RTX PRO 6000, DGX Spark/GB10) there is no FA3/FA4, so DiffKV models (K/V head sizes differ; MiMo-V2: 192/128) run every attention step on `TRITON_ATTN_DIFFKV`. This PR adds `TRITON_FLASHINFER_DIFFKV`, built with the existing `create_composite_attention_backend`. It routes batches that contain a prefill on plain causal full-attention layers to FlashInfer's paged prefill (`head_dim_vo`), using the same packed cache. Decode-only and verification-only batches, and all CUDA graph capture and replay, stay on `TRITON_ATTN_DIFFKV`. Related: - #58177 and #59673 optimize the Triton DiffKV kernel. They are complementary and are benchmarked against below. - #59052 pins Triton DiffKV to `UNIFORM_BATCH` CUDA graphs, the same support level this composite reports. - #46963 also uses FlashInfer prefill on SM12x. ## Claims All on DGX Spark (GB10, SM121), MiMo-V2.6-Flash. - **Prefill attention, one full-attention layer at TP2,** vs Triton DiffKV with #58177 + #59673 applied. Cold-L2 CUDA-graph timing; `plan()` host time is reported separately below. - 2.27–2.29× for 512+-token chunks over a 32K prefix; - 2.17× for a fresh 8K chunk, 1.84× fresh 2K, 1.24× fresh 512; - 3.07× for 64 tokens and 6.41× for 17 tokens over a 32K prefix; - slower for fresh chunks of ≤64 tokens: 0.45–0.83×, i.e. 1.2–3.6 µs per layer. - **End to end on the PR base** (main `18c19eaf2` with and without this PR): cold-prefill TTFT at 96K tokens goes from 72.3 s to 40.6 s (**1.78×**); 1.46× at 48K, 1.23× at 24K. - Single-request decode is unchanged. - Fresh 23–34-token prompts are 2–6 ms slower at p50 (1–4%); 66–515-token prompts are 4–10 ms faster. - **Accuracy:** no observed degradation in gsm8k or full-vocabulary logprobs. - **Cost:** on this configuration the KV cache is 0.59 GiB smaller (6.6% fewer tokens), mostly from FlashInfer's workspace (details below). - **Off switch:** `VLLM_DIFFKV_FLASHINFER_PREFILL=0` restores `TRITON_ATTN_DIFFKV` for every layer. ## Validation **Not a duplicate.** I searched open and closed PRs for `diffkv flashinfer`, `DiffKV FlashInfer prefill`, `TRITON_ATTN_DIFFKV`, `diffkv sm120` and `MiMo FlashInfer prefill`. None route DiffKV attention to FlashInfer. ### Environments The hardware is GB10 throughout. SM120 (RTX 5090 / RTX PRO 6000) is **not validated**; confirmation from an SM120 owner is requested. | label | vLLM | FlashInfer | used for | |---|---|---|---| | **PR base** | main `18c19eaf2` precompiled cu130 aarch64 wheel; "+PR" adds this PR's Python files (the PR changes no compiled code) | 0.7.0.post1 (main's pin) | tests, layer timing, end-to-end A/B, short-prompt TTFT | | **rebased** | this PR as `c379d3fab` on main `74f4404f5`, run from the main `fe4df3df0` wheel (one unrelated commit earlier) + this PR's files | 0.7.0.post1 | tests, serving re-check | | **old base** | `7f1a539` + this change (plus a local `max_decode_query_len` shim) | 0.6.18.post1 | gsm8k, logprobs, mixed load | - **Shared stack:** torch 2.13.0+cu130 and triton 3.7.1. The MoE backend is b12x 1.5.0, which needs `nvidia-cutlass-dsl` 4.7.1 (main pins 4.8.0); this only affects the MoE path. - **Model:** `XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-V2.6-Flash-MOPD` @ `2479e2d0029e`. - **Server:** ```bash vllm serve MiMo-V2.6-Flash-MOPD --tensor-parallel-size 2 --nnodes 2 \ --distributed-executor-backend mp --gpu-memory-utilization 0.87 \ --max-model-len 300000 --max-num-seqs 16 --moe-backend b12x \ --no-async-scheduling --trust-remote-code --generation-config vllm \ --speculative-config '{"method":"dflash","model":"MiMo-V2.6-Flash-MOPD/dflash","num_speculative_tokens":7}' ``` - **Video profiling:** on the PR base both arms also pass `--limit-mm-per-prompt '{"video": 0}'`. Main's encoder profiling with a maximum-size video exhausted GB10's unified memory during startup and hung the GPU driver, independent of this PR. All workloads below are text-only. - **Rebase:** #57169 removed `set_kernel_block_size()` from the metadata builder base class; the builder now takes its page size from `kv_cache_spec.block_size`, as other builders on main do. - **Memory on the rebased base:** at `--gpu-memory-utilization 0.87`, main `fe4df3df0` + PR sized the KV cache at 20.05 GiB, compared with 18.42 GiB for `18c19eaf2` + PR with the same flags. Host MemAvailable then fell below 3 GB during startup warmup, and my watchdog stopped the server. The re-check therefore ran at 0.85. I did not measure main without this PR on this base, so the cause of the larger KV cache is not isolated. ### Tests ```bash pytest -v tests/kernels/attention/test_flashinfer_diffkv_prefill.py ``` | environment | result | |---|---| | rebased (main `fe4df3df0` + PR), FlashInfer 0.7.0.post1 | **99 passed** | | PR base (+PR), FlashInfer 0.7.0.post1 | **99 passed** | | old base, FlashInfer 0.6.18.post1 | 98 passed, 1 failed | The old-base failure is `test_layer_eligibility[kwargs3]` (FP8 KV), which needs #58128 (on main). **Numerics.** The backend's own plan/run is checked against an FP32 PyTorch reference, because the existing DiffKV test needs FA3/FA4 and skips on SM12x. - Inputs: - a scattered block table; - physical layouts HND / NHD, each with and without layer interleaving; - block sizes 16 and 64; - a fresh 2K prompt, 2K over an 8K prefix, 256 over a 32K prefix, and 17 over an 8K prefix; - a mixed batch with decode rows. - Checks: `assert_close(atol=rtol=2e-2)` and relative L2 < 1e-2. - An FP16 subset covers both layouts. **Behavior** tests check: - auto-selection and its fallbacks: sinks, sliding window, FP8 KV, unvalidated head sizes, and the opt-out variable; - per-layer eligibility on real impls; - `host_seq_lens` for pure-prefill (no readback) and mixed speculative batches (exact lengths); - that the capture variant is Triton for uniform batches up to `1 + num_speculative_tokens`. **GPU sync.** Repeated pure-prefill and mixed speculative plan+run steps pass after warmup under `VLLM_GPU_SYNC_CHECK=error`, via `enable_gpu_sync_check` and `with_gpu_sync_check`. With pinned staging disabled, the checker raises on the unpinned non-blocking copy. (Old base, both FlashInfer versions.) **CI coverage.** Buildkite has no SM12x runner, so the GPU cases skip in CI. ### Layer timing (PR base) ```bash python benchmarks/kernels/benchmark_flashinfer_diffkv_prefill.py --method cudagraph \ --block-sizes 64 --chunk 17 64 512 2048 8192 --prefix 0 32768 ``` - MiMo-V2.6-Flash full-attention layer, TP2 (32 q / 2 KV heads, K192/V128, BF16), one request, block size 64. - Median of FlashInfer's `bench_gpu_time_with_cudagraph` with `cold_l2_cache=True`. Inputs are preallocated and passed through the timer, so it rotates them. CUPTI was unavailable. - Triton+PRs is main's kernel with #58177 @ `2e41b30` and #59673 @ `9103f7d` applied; their outputs are bit-identical to main's. | chunk | prefix | Triton main (µs) | Triton+PRs (µs) | this PR (µs) | vs Triton+PRs | vs main | |---|---|---|---|---|---|---| | 17 | 0 | 3.0 | 3.0 | 6.6 | 0.45× | 0.45× | | 17 | 32K | 1,399 | 1,446 | 225 | 6.41× | 6.23× | | 64 | 0 | 7.7 | 6.1 | 7.3 | 0.83× | 1.06× | | 64 | 32K | 3,108 | 1,737 | 566 | 3.07× | 5.50× | | 512 | 0 | 153 | 102 | 83 | 1.24× | 1.85× | | 512 | 32K | 17,435 | 10,979 | 4,846 | 2.27× | 3.60× | | 2K | 0 | 2,092 | 1,211 | 660 | 1.84× | 3.20× | | 2K | 32K | 70,411 | 41,449 | 18,291 | 2.27× | 3.86× | | 8K | 0 | 34,095 | 19,443 | 8,964 | 2.17× | 3.78× | | 8K | 32K | 314,982 | 180,821 | 79,054 | 2.29× | 3.96× | - Relative L2 against Triton is 6.6e-4 to 3.9e-3. - Warm-L2 timing (same buffers repeated) gave the same speedups within 3%, except fresh 512 (1.47× warm vs 1.24× cold). **Per-step costs added by the FlashInfer path,** reported separately because host planning can overlap GPU work: - Kernel: 1.2–3.6 µs slower per layer for fresh chunks of ≤64 tokens, about 11–32 µs per step over MiMo's 9 full-attention layers. Faster for every other measured shape. - `plan()`: 101–134 µs host time per step that routes to FlashInfer (median of 20 calls), shared by all layers. One outlier: 548 µs for the fresh 17-token case in the Triton+PRs run. That was the first case in its process (after one untimed `plan()` call), and the identical case measured 104 µs in the Triton-main run. A warmup effect is likely, but I did not verify it, so it is reported here rather than excluded (raw log: `results_v8_bench_coldl2_triton_prs.txt`). - Serving impact, measured directly in the short-prompt table below. ### End to end on the PR base (main ± PR) Single request, cache-cold prompts. | prompt tokens | main TTFT | main + PR TTFT | speedup | |---|---|---|---| | 1.5K | 0.78 s | 0.75 s | 1.04× | | 6K | 2.17 s | 1.96 s | 1.11× | | 24K | 9.95 s | 8.12 s | 1.23× | | 48K | 25.33 s | 17.40 s | 1.46× | | 96K | 72.31 s | 40.59 s | 1.78× | - **Decode** (2048 tokens, DFlash k=7): main 55.9 / 53.7 (code) and 29.0 / 27.9 (prose) tok/s; main + PR 54.4 / 53.4 and 29.2 / 28.1 tok/s. - **Engine logs:** - main + PR selects `TRITON_FLASHINFER_DIFFKV` for full-attention layers and `TRITON_ATTN_DIFFKV` for SWA layers, on Model Runner V2. - Both arms captured full decode and DFlash CUDA graphs. - Chat and tool-call smoke requests succeeded on both. - **Old base** (`7f1a539` ± this change): the same TTFT pattern, 96K 72.8 s → 40.6 s. **Short cache-cold prompts.** One request at a time, 30 requests per size, `max_tokens=1`, after warmup; one server start per arm. | prompt tokens | main p50 / p90 | main + PR p50 / p90 | Δ p50 | |---|---|---|---| | 23 | 173.0 / 185.5 ms | 179.5 / 187.5 ms | +6.5 ms | | 34 | 198.3 / 211.7 ms | 200.6 / 214.4 ms | +2.3 ms | | 66 | 228.3 / 235.7 ms | 224.1 / 235.3 ms | −4.2 ms | | 129 | 266.5 / 286.1 ms | 256.0 / 276.7 ms | −10.5 ms | | 515 | 296.9 / 301.3 ms | 291.2 / 296.6 ms | −5.7 ms | ### Re-check after rebase (main `fe4df3df0` + PR, 0.85) One server start, PR arm only. There is no main arm on this base, so the speedups above come from the PR base. - The engine log selects `TRITON_FLASHINFER_DIFFKV` for full-attention layers and `TRITON_ATTN_DIFFKV` for SWA layers. Chat and tool-call smoke requests succeeded. - Cold-prefill TTFT: 1.5K 0.74 s, 6K 1.98 s, 24K 8.33 s, 48K 17.44 s, 96K 41.25 s (PR base: 0.75, 1.96, 8.12, 17.40, 40.59 s). - Decode: 53.8 / 49.3 (code) and 28.0 / 26.9 (prose) tok/s. - Short prompts, p50: 23 tokens 178.2 ms, 34 207.9 ms, 66 225.5 ms, 129 265.7 ms, 515 299.2 ms. ### Concurrent generation with arriving prompts (old base) - Workload: 8 streams generating up to 600 tokens (DFlash k=7, temperature 0). - Phase A has no arrivals. Phase B adds a cache-cold 8K-token prompt every 6 s, so prefill shares batches with decode/verify rows. - One run per arm. - **The arms got different random arrival prompts of the same length.** The workload seeded with `hash()`, which is randomized per process; the script now uses a fixed seed. | phase | metric | base | this PR | |---|---|---|---| | decode only | stream tok/s | 127.8 | 124.3 | | decode only | chunk gap p50 / p99 | 249 / 316 ms | 250 / 329 ms | | with arrivals | stream tok/s | 88.8 | 92.7 | | with arrivals | chunk gap p50 / p90 / p99 | 262 / 775 / 846 ms | 260 / 741 / 759 ms | | with arrivals | arrival TTFT mean / p90 | 3.76 / 3.86 s | 3.50 / 3.64 s | No regression was observed in one synchronous-scheduling run (`--no-async-scheduling`). The decode-only phase runs identical code, which suggests about ±3% noise. Async scheduling is not measured. ### gsm8k (old base) ```bash python tests/evals/gsm8k/gsm8k_eval.py --port 8000 --use-chat-completions \ --max-tokens 1024 --temperature 0 --max-concurrency 32 \ --request-timeout-seconds 14400 --chat-template-kwargs '{"enable_thinking": false}' ``` 1319 questions, 5-shot, chat, thinking off; two runs each. | config | run 1 | run 2 | invalid | |---|---|---|---| | base (`TRITON_ATTN_DIFFKV`) | 0.963 | 0.961 | 0.0% | | this PR | 0.961 | 0.964 | 0.0% | The longer timeout is needed because the evaluator starts all 1319 requests at once behind a connection limit. Each request's `aiohttp` timeout includes time spent waiting for a connection, so queued requests expired at the 600 s default.
Full-vocabulary logprobs vs base (old base) These are `prompt_logprobs` on a fixed text set, compared token by token. The noise column is two runs of one fixed configuration against each other. | text | tokens | mean \|Δ logprob\| | ppl ratio | top-1 agree | noise \|Δ\| / ppl | |---|---|---|---|---|---| | code (agent) | 1785 | 0.0941 | 0.997 | 97.4% | 0.0896 / 1.001 | | code (site) | 1931 | 0.0573 | 0.997 | 98.0% | 0.0518 / 0.996 | | prose | 529 | 0.0194 | 1.002 | 100.0% | 0.0246 / 1.011 | | json | 2330 | 0.0045 | 1.002 | 100.0% | 0.0041 / 1.002 | | math | 1376 | 0.0054 | 0.999 | 99.9% | 0.0068 / 0.999 | | tool call | 303 | 0.8095 | 1.211 | 98.7% | 0.7744 / 0.982 | The tool-call sample is short and high-entropy (mean NLL 4.3). Its perplexity ratio swings by about ±20% even between two runs of the identical FlashInfer kernel (1.246).
Raw results, logs and scripts: https://gist.github.com/siddharth1825/7e3c542800bef7f7ee6c03f6ba80487c ## Details ### Selection `MiMoV2Attention` keeps its order: FA DiffKV when FA3/FA4 is usable, then `TRITON_FLASHINFER_DIFFKV`, then `TRITON_ATTN_DIFFKV`. The new backend is auto-selected only when all of these hold: - CUDA, compute capability 12.x, FlashInfer present; - full attention: no sliding window, no sinks; - FP16/BF16 compute with a 16-bit KV cache; - head sizes (192, 128), the only pair tested. It is also selectable with `--attention-backend TRITON_FLASHINFER_DIFFKV`. ### Routing - FlashInfer when the batch's longest query exceeds `max(16, max_decode_query_len)`; Triton otherwise, and for image-prefix batches. - Decode or verify rows that share a batch with a prefill run on FlashInfer with it. - `capture_variant = 0`. The threshold is never below the uniform decode/verify width, so CUDA graph replay always selects Triton. - A KV cache group containing any layer FlashInfer does not cover (window, sinks, ALiBi, soft-cap, FP8 KV) always uses Triton. - The 16-token floor is not tuned for fresh prompts. Over a cached prefix, FlashInfer wins from 17 tokens; fresh prompts break even around 64 tokens. ### Metadata - `plan()` runs once per step in the builder, shared by every layer in the group. - As in `FlashInferMetadataBuilder.build`, the query offsets, page offsets, last-page lengths and an explicit `seq_lens` are staged in pinned memory, so `plan()`'s non-blocking copies stay asynchronous. - The builder reuses `_copy_page_indices_kernel` and joins the composite's workspace sharing. ### Host sequence lengths - `seq_lens_cpu_upper_bound` is exact for prefill rows, and for all rows without speculative decoding, so those batches never read back from the GPU. - A batch with a row that may be a spec-decode row (query length ≤ `max_decode_query_len`) reads exact `seq_lens` back inside `gpu_sync_allowed()`. That row's upper bound assumes every draft was accepted, and FlashInfer needs exact lengths. - Without async scheduling the bound is often exact too. That is not used, because MRV2 adaptive verification also makes per-row token counts an upper bound. ### Cache and FlashInfer path - The FlashInfer child subclasses the Triton DiffKV backend, so both share one cache spec and tensor. K/V are passed as last-dim strided views of the packed cache, in HND or NHD physical layout, with or without layer interleaving. - The call is `BatchPrefillWithPagedKVCacheWrapper(workspace, "HND")` with `plan(..., head_dim_vo=128, causal=True, seq_lens=...)`; the wrapper resolves to the `fa2` backend on SM12x. - The SM120 fused 192×128 kernels reported unreachable in the 0.6.18/0.7.0 wrappers are not used. - **JIT build on 0.7.0.post1.** The aarch64 `flashinfer-jit-cache` wheel is a stub that depends on per-architecture packages vLLM does not install, so the 192/128 module is JIT-built on first use: 19 s in isolation. In serving it completes during startup; the first long prompt after a restart was not measurably slower. ### Memory - **Workspace.** It is sized like the FlashInfer backend's: `max(VLLM_FLASHINFER_WORKSPACE_BUFFER_SIZE, tokens × heads × head_dim × 16)`. With this config's 2048-token budget, that resolves to the 394 MB default. - **KV cache.** On the PR base, KV cache memory went from 19.01 to 18.42 GiB (1,428,918 → 1,335,006 tokens). - **Possible follow-up.** A smaller floor for this prefill-only use could recover most of it. It is not changed here: FlashInfer errors rather than grows when the workspace is too small, and the default is the same one the FlashInfer backend uses. ### Why decode and CUDA graphs stay on Triton - Decode is bandwidth-bound with short queries. Triton DiffKV already has 2D/3D split-KV paths for it, and measured decode was unchanged. - Only Triton is captured. Moving decode/verify-only batches to FlashInfer needs a graph-safe DiffKV decode/verify plan (persistent buffers, `fast_plan`), which is a separate change. - **Cost.** The composite reports `UNIFORM_BATCH` instead of `ALWAYS`. - Under the default `FULL_AND_PIECEWISE`, uniform decode still runs as full graphs, and mixed batches already ran piecewise. - Only `cudagraph_mode=FULL` with mixed batches loses full graphs on these layers. ### Complexity About 460 new lines in one new backend file, plus small edits: - selection: 18 lines in `mimo_v2.py`; - the env var; - the registry entry; - docs. There are no changes to the model runner, scheduler, KV cache manager or the Triton kernel. ### AI assistance Claude (Anthropic) was used to write the change, run the tests and benchmarks on our DGX Sparks, and draft this description. I reviewed every changed line and the validation results. cc @mgoin: SM12x + FlashInfer prefill, related to #46963. ---

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,163 @@
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""TRITON_ATTN_DIFFKV vs TRITON_FLASHINFER_DIFFKV prefill on one layer.
+
+Defaults are a MiMo-V2 full-attention layer at TP2 (32 query heads, 2 KV
+heads, K/V head sizes 192/128, BF16): one request prefilling ``--chunk``
+tokens on top of ``--prefix`` cached tokens. Both kernels get preallocated
+inputs, passed through the timer so it can rotate them for cold-L2 timing.
+FlashInfer's per-step ``plan()`` (host time, shared by every layer in a step)
+is reported separately.
+"""
+
+import argparse
+import time
+from functools import partial
+
+import numpy as np
+import torch
+from flashinfer import BatchPrefillWithPagedKVCacheWrapper
+
+from vllm.utils.math_utils import cdiv, next_power_of_2
+from vllm.v1.attention.backends.triton_flashinfer_diffkv import (
+    plan_paged_prefill,
+    run_paged_prefill,
+)
+from vllm.v1.attention.ops.triton_unified_attention_diffkv import (
+    unified_attention_diffkv,
+)
+from vllm.v1.utils import CpuGpuBuffer
+
+NUM_SEGMENTS = 16
+
+
+def _timer(method: str):
+    if method == "cupti":
+        from flashinfer.testing import bench_gpu_time_with_cupti
+
+        return partial(
+            bench_gpu_time_with_cupti, use_cuda_graph=True, cold_l2_cache=True
+        )
+    if method == "cudagraph":
+        from flashinfer.testing import bench_gpu_time_with_cudagraph
+
+        return partial(bench_gpu_time_with_cudagraph, cold_l2_cache=True)
+    raise ValueError(f"unknown timing method: {method}")
+
+
+@torch.inference_mode()
+def benchmark(args, timer, chunk: int, prefix: int, block_size: int) -> None:
+    hq, hkv, dqk, dv = args.num_q_heads, args.num_kv_heads, args.qk_dim, args.v_dim
+    dtype, scale = torch.bfloat16, dqk**-0.5
+    kv_len = prefix + chunk
+    pages = cdiv(kv_len, block_size)
+    num_blocks = pages + 64
+    cache = torch.randn(num_blocks, hkv, block_size, dqk + dv, dtype=dtype)
+    block_table = torch.randperm(num_blocks)[:pages].to(torch.int32)[None]
+    query = torch.randn(chunk, hq, dqk, dtype=dtype)
+    out_triton = torch.empty(chunk, hq, dv, dtype=dtype)
+    out_fi = torch.empty_like(out_triton)
+
+    cu_seqlens_q = torch.tensor([0, chunk], dtype=torch.int32)
+    seqused_k = torch.tensor([kv_len], dtype=torch.int32)
+    segm_output = torch.empty(
+        0, hq, NUM_SEGMENTS, next_power_of_2(dv), dtype=torch.float32
+    )
+    segm_max = torch.empty(0, hq, NUM_SEGMENTS, dtype=torch.float32)
+    segm_expsum = torch.empty(0, hq, NUM_SEGMENTS, dtype=torch.float32)
+
+    def triton(query, cache, out):
+        nhd = cache.transpose(1, 2)
+        unified_attention_diffkv(
+            q=query,
+            k=nhd[..., :dqk],
+            v=nhd[..., dqk:],
+            out=out,
+            cu_seqlens_q=cu_seqlens_q,
+            seqused_k=seqused_k,
+            softmax_scale=scale,
+            causal=True,
+            window_size=(-1, -1),
+            block_table=block_table,
+            softcap=0,
+            max_seqlen_q=chunk,
+            seq_threshold_3D=0,
+            num_par_softmax_segments=NUM_SEGMENTS,
+            softmax_segm_output=segm_output,
+            softmax_segm_max=segm_max,
+            softmax_segm_expsum=segm_expsum,
+        )
+
+    wrapper = BatchPrefillWithPagedKVCacheWrapper(
+        torch.zeros(256 << 20, dtype=torch.uint8), "HND"
+    )
+    plan = partial(
+        plan_paged_prefill,
+        wrapper,
+        qo_indptr_cpu=torch.tensor([0, chunk], dtype=torch.int32, device="cpu"),
+        seq_lens_cpu=torch.tensor([kv_len], dtype=torch.int32, device="cpu"),
+        block_table=block_table,
+        page_size=block_size,
+        paged_kv_indptr=CpuGpuBuffer(2, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda"),
+        paged_kv_indices=torch.zeros(pages, dtype=torch.int32),
+        paged_kv_last_page_len=CpuGpuBuffer(1, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda"),
+        num_qo_heads=hq,
+        num_kv_heads=hkv,
+        head_size_qk=dqk,
+        head_size_v=dv,
+        sm_scale=scale,
+        q_dtype=dtype,
+        kv_dtype=dtype,
+    )
+    plan()
+    plan_us = []
+    for _ in range(20):
+        torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+        start = time.perf_counter()
+        plan()
+        plan_us.append((time.perf_counter() - start) * 1e6)
+
+    def flashinfer(query, cache, out):
+        run_paged_prefill(wrapper, query, cache, out, dqk, dv)
+
+    t_triton = float(np.median(timer(triton, input_args=(query, cache, out_triton))))
+    t_fi = float(np.median(timer(flashinfer, input_args=(query, cache, out_fi))))
+    triton(query, cache, out_triton)
+    flashinfer(query, cache, out_fi)
+    visible = chunk * prefix + chunk * (chunk + 1) / 2
+    tflop = 2 * hq * visible * (dqk + dv) / 1e12
+    rel_l2 = (out_fi.float() - out_triton.float()).norm() / out_triton.float().norm()
+    print(
+        f"{block_size:>5} {chunk:>6} {prefix:>7} {t_triton * 1e3:>10.1f} "
+        f"{t_fi * 1e3:>9.1f} {t_triton / t_fi:>7.2f}x {np.median(plan_us):>8.0f} "

+"""FlashInfer DiffKV prefill (TRITON_FLASHINFER_DIFFKV) vs an exact reference.
+
+Drives the backend's own ``plan_paged_prefill`` / ``run_paged_prefill`` on the
+DiffKV packed cache ``[num_blocks, num_kv_heads, block_size, hqk + hv]`` with a
+scattered block table, and checks the output against an FP32 reference.
+"""

+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+from vllm.utils.flashinfer import has_flashinfer
+from vllm.utils.math_utils import cdiv
+from vllm.utils.torch_utils import set_random_seed

+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skip_global_cleanup

+requires_sm12x_flashinfer = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not current_platform.is_cuda()
+    or not current_platform.is_device_capability_family(120)
+    or not has_flashinfer(),
+    reason="TRITON_FLASHINFER_DIFFKV is gated to sm_12x with FlashInfer",
+)

+HEAD_SIZE_QK, HEAD_SIZE_V = 192, 128
+# (num_query_heads, num_kv_heads): MiMo-V2 full attention at TP2, and one KV head.
+NUM_HEADS = [(32, 2), (16, 1)]
+# (query_len, kv_len) per request.
+SEQ_LENS = [
+    [(2048, 2048)],  # fresh prompt
+    [(2048, 2048 + 8192)],  # chunked prefill over an 8K prefix
+    [(256, 256 + 32768)],  # short chunk over a 32K prefix
+    [(17, 17 + 8192), (1, 300)],  # just above the routing threshold
+    [(1, 1328), (37, 500), (1024, 1024 + 4096), (1, 77)],  # mixed with decode rows
+]
+LAYOUTS = ["HND", "NHD", "HND_interleaved", "NHD_interleaved"]
+
+
+def _packed_cache(layout, num_blocks, num_kv_heads, block_size, dtype):
+    """Logical (B, H, N, C) cache with the physical strides of ``layout``.
+
+    ``*_interleaved`` places a second layer's block between consecutive blocks,
+    as the block-compact layer-interleaved layouts do.
+    """
+    content = HEAD_SIZE_QK + HEAD_SIZE_V
+    head_major = layout.startswith("HND")
+    inner = (
+        (num_kv_heads, block_size, content)
+        if head_major
+        else (block_size, num_kv_heads, content)
+    )
+    if layout.endswith("interleaved"):
+        cache = torch.randn(num_blocks, 2, *inner, dtype=dtype)[:, 1]
+    else:
+        cache = torch.randn(num_blocks, *inner, dtype=dtype)
+    return cache if head_major else cache.transpose(1, 2)
+
+
+def _reference(query, cache, block_table, query_lens, kv_lens, scale):
+    """FP32 causal attention over the HND packed cache, gathered per request."""
+    _, num_kv_heads, block_size, _ = cache.shape
+    num_heads = query.shape[1]
+    out = torch.empty(query.shape[0], num_heads, HEAD_SIZE_V, dtype=torch.float32)
+    start = 0
+    for i, (q_len, kv_len) in enumerate(zip(query_lens, kv_lens)):
+        blocks = block_table[i, : cdiv(kv_len, block_size)].long()
+        seq = (
+            cache[blocks].permute(0, 2, 1, 3).reshape(-1, num_kv_heads, cache.shape[-1])
+        )
+        seq = seq[:kv_len].float()
+        k = seq[..., :HEAD_SIZE_QK].repeat_interleave(num_heads // num_kv_heads, 1)
+        v = seq[..., HEAD_SIZE_QK:].repeat_interleave(num_heads // num_kv_heads, 1)
+        q = query[start : start + q_len].float()
+        q_pos = torch.arange(kv_len - q_len, kv_len)
+        k_pos = torch.arange(kv_len)
+        for h in range(0, num_heads, 8):  # bound the score matrix
+            s = torch.einsum("qhd,khd->hqk", q[:, h : h + 8], k[:, h : h + 8]) * scale
+            s.masked_fill_(k_pos[None, None, :] > q_pos[None, :, None], float("-inf"))
+            out[start : start + q_len, h : h + 8] = torch.einsum(
+                "hqk,khd->qhd", s.softmax(-1), v[:, h : h + 8]
+            )
+        start += q_len
+    return out
+

+def _check_prefill(seq_lens, num_heads, block_size, layout, dtype):

+    )

+    torch.set_default_device("cuda")
+    set_random_seed(0)
+    num_query_heads, num_kv_heads = num_heads
+    query_lens = [q for q, _ in seq_lens]

+    pages = [cdiv(k, block_size) for k in kv_lens]

+    perm = torch.randperm(num_blocks, dtype=torch.int32)

+    offset = 0

+        block_table=block_table,

+"""DiffKV attention routing prefill to FlashInfer and the rest to Triton.
+
+Prefill steps of plain causal full-attention layers run FlashInfer's paged
+prefill (``head_dim_vo != head_dim_qk``) directly on the Triton DiffKV packed

+``TRITON_ATTN_DIFFKV``.

+import torch

+)

+    requires_mm_prefix,
+)

+
+_WORKSPACE_BYTES_PER_ELEM = 16
+

+def plan_paged_prefill(
+    wrapper: Any,
+    *,

+    seq_lens_cpu: torch.Tensor,
+    block_table: torch.Tensor,
+    page_size: int,

+    paged_kv_indices: torch.Tensor,

+    num_qo_heads: int,
+    num_kv_heads: int,
+    head_size_qk: int,
+    head_size_v: int,
+    sm_scale: float,
+    q_dtype: torch.dtype,
+    kv_dtype: torch.dtype,

+
+    seq_lens_np = seq_lens_cpu.numpy()
+    num_reqs = seq_lens_np.shape[0]
+    num_pages = (seq_lens_np + page_size - 1) // page_size
+    np.cumsum(num_pages, dtype=np.int32, out=paged_kv_indptr.np[1 : num_reqs + 1])

+        BLOCK_SIZE=1024,
+    )
+    last = seq_lens_np % page_size
+    paged_kv_last_page_len.np[:num_reqs] = np.where(
+        (last == 0) & (seq_lens_np != 0), page_size, last
+    )
+    kv_indptr_cpu = paged_kv_indptr.cpu[: num_reqs + 1]
+    last_page_len_cpu = paged_kv_last_page_len.cpu[:num_reqs]
+    seq_lens_cpu = seq_lens_cpu.to(torch.int32)
+    # plan() copies these to the GPU with non_blocking=True; stage them in
+    # pinned memory so the copies stay async, as FlashInferMetadataBuilder does.
+    if PIN_MEMORY:
+        qo_indptr_cpu = qo_indptr_cpu.pin_memory()
+        kv_indptr_cpu = kv_indptr_cpu.pin_memory()
+        last_page_len_cpu = last_page_len_cpu.pin_memory()
+        seq_lens_cpu = seq_lens_cpu.pin_memory()
+    wrapper.plan(
+        qo_indptr_cpu,
+        kv_indptr_cpu,
+        indices,
+        last_page_len_cpu,
+        num_qo_heads,
+        num_kv_heads,
+        head_size_qk,
+        page_size,
+        head_dim_vo=head_size_v,
+        causal=True,
+        sm_scale=sm_scale,
+        q_data_type=q_dtype,
+        kv_data_type=kv_dtype,
+        seq_lens=seq_lens_cpu,
+    )
+
+
+def host_seq_lens(
+    common_attn_metadata: CommonAttentionMetadata, max_decode_query_len: int
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Exact per-request KV lengths on the host.
+
+    ``seq_lens_cpu_upper_bound`` is exact for prefill rows and, without
+    speculative decoding, for every row. Only batches that may contain
+    spec-decode rows (query length <= ``max_decode_query_len``) read the exact
+    lengths back from the GPU.
+    """
+    cm = common_attn_metadata
+    num_reqs = cm.num_reqs
+    upper = cm.seq_lens_cpu_upper_bound
+    if upper is not None:
+        query_lens = (
+            cm.query_start_loc_cpu[1 : num_reqs + 1]
+            - (cm.query_start_loc_cpu[:num_reqs])
+        )
+        if max_decode_query_len == 1 or bool((query_lens > max_decode_query_len).all()):
+            return upper[:num_reqs]
+    with gpu_sync_allowed():
+        return cm.seq_lens[:num_reqs].cpu()
+
+
+def supports_flashinfer_prefill(impl: Any) -> bool:
+    return (
+        impl.sliding_window in (None, (-1, -1))
+        and impl.sinks is None
+        and impl.alibi_slopes is None
+        and not impl.logits_soft_cap
+        and not is_quantized_kv_cache(impl.kv_cache_dtype)
+    )
+
+
+def run_paged_prefill(
+    wrapper: Any,
+    query: torch.Tensor,
+    kv_cache: torch.Tensor,
+    output: torch.Tensor,
+    head_size_qk: int,
+    head_size_v: int,
+) -> None:
+    """Run on the logical (B, H, N, hqk + hv) cache; K/V are strided views."""
+    wrapper.run(
+        query,
+        (
+            kv_cache[..., :head_size_qk],
+            kv_cache[..., head_size_qk : head_size_qk + head_size_v],
+        ),
+        out=output,
+    )
+
+
+@dataclass
+class FlashInferDiffKVMetadata:
+    num_actual_tokens: int
+    prefill_wrapper: Any
+
+
+class FlashInferDiffKVMetadataBuilder(
+    AttentionMetadataBuilder[FlashInferDiffKVMetadata]
+):
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        kv_cache_spec: AttentionSpec,
+        layer_names: list[str],
+        vllm_config: VllmConfig,
+        device: torch.device,
+    ):
+        super().__init__(kv_cache_spec, layer_names, vllm_config, device)
+        from flashinfer import BatchPrefillWithPagedKVCacheWrapper
+
+        self._wrapper_cls = BatchPrefillWithPagedKVCacheWrapper
+        self._wrapper = None
+        self._workspace_buffer: torch.Tensor | None = None
+
+        impls = [
+            cast(Any, getattr(layer, "impl", layer))
+            for layer in get_layers_from_vllm_config(
+                vllm_config,
+                AttentionLayerBase,  # type: ignore[type-abstract]
+                layer_names,
+            ).values()
+        ]
+        shapes = {(i.num_heads, i.num_kv_heads, i.head_size, i.scale) for i in impls}
+        assert len(shapes) == 1, f"non-uniform attention layers in group: {shapes}"
+        self.num_qo_heads, self.num_kv_heads, self.head_size_qk, self.scale = (
+            shapes.pop()
+        )
+        self.head_size_v = TritonAttentionDiffKVBackend.head_size_v
+        self.q_dtype = vllm_config.model_config.dtype
+        self.kv_dtype = kv_cache_spec.dtype
+        self.kernel_block_size = kv_cache_spec.block_size
+        self.max_decode_query_len = max_decode_query_len(vllm_config)
+
+        scheduler_config = vllm_config.scheduler_config
+        self.max_num_batched_tokens = scheduler_config.max_num_batched_tokens
+        max_num_reqs = scheduler_config.max_num_seqs
+        max_num_pages = max_num_reqs * cdiv(
+            vllm_config.model_config.max_model_len, self.kernel_block_size
+        )
+        self.paged_kv_indptr = CpuGpuBuffer(
+            max_num_reqs + 1, dtype=torch.int32, device=device, pin_memory=False
+        )
+        self.paged_kv_indices = torch.zeros(
+            max_num_pages, dtype=torch.int32, device=device
+        )
+        self.paged_kv_last_page_len = CpuGpuBuffer(
+            max_num_reqs, dtype=torch.int32, device=device, pin_memory=False
+        )
+
+    @classmethod
+    def get_cudagraph_support(
+        cls, vllm_config: VllmConfig, kv_cache_spec: KVCacheSpec
+    ) -> AttentionCGSupport:
+        # Never captured; DiffKVPrefillRouting bounds the composite's support.
+        return AttentionCGSupport.ALWAYS
+
+    def _get_workspace_buffer(self) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if self._workspace_buffer is None:
+            size = max(
+                envs.VLLM_FLASHINFER_WORKSPACE_BUFFER_SIZE,
+                self.max_num_batched_tokens
+                * self.num_qo_heads
+                * max(self.head_size_qk, self.head_size_v)
+                * _WORKSPACE_BYTES_PER_ELEM,
+            )
+            self._workspace_buffer = torch.zeros(
+                size, dtype=torch.uint8, device=self.device
+            )
+        return self._workspace_buffer
+
+    def set_workspace_buffer(self, workspace_buffer: torch.Tensor) -> None:
+        self._workspace_buffer = workspace_buffer
+        self._wrapper = None
+
+    def build(
+        self,
+        common_prefix_len: int,
+        common_attn_metadata: CommonAttentionMetadata,
+        fast_build: bool = False,
+    ) -> FlashInferDiffKVMetadata:
+        cm = common_attn_metadata
+        num_reqs = cm.num_reqs
+        if self._wrapper is None:
+            self._wrapper = self._wrapper_cls(self._get_workspace_buffer(), "HND")
+        qo_indptr_cpu = cm.query_start_loc_cpu[: num_reqs + 1]
+        plan_paged_prefill(
+            self._wrapper,
+            qo_indptr_cpu=qo_indptr_cpu,
+            seq_lens_cpu=host_seq_lens(cm, self.max_decode_query_len),
+            block_table=cm.block_table_tensor,
+            page_size=self.kernel_block_size,
+            paged_kv_indptr=self.paged_kv_indptr,
+            paged_kv_indices=self.paged_kv_indices,
+            paged_kv_last_page_len=self.paged_kv_last_page_len,
+            num_qo_heads=self.num_qo_heads,
+            num_kv_heads=self.num_kv_heads,
+            head_size_qk=self.head_size_qk,
+            head_size_v=self.head_size_v,
+            sm_scale=self.scale,
+            q_dtype=self.q_dtype,
+            kv_dtype=self.kv_dtype,
+        )
+        return FlashInferDiffKVMetadata(
+            num_actual_tokens=int(qo_indptr_cpu[num_reqs]),
+            prefill_wrapper=self._wrapper,
+        )
+
+
+class FlashInferDiffKVImpl(TritonAttentionDiffKVImpl):
+    def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs) -> None:
+        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
+        self.flashinfer_supported = supports_flashinfer_prefill(self)
+
+    def forward(  # type: ignore[override]
+        self,
+        layer: torch.nn.Module,
+        query: torch.Tensor,
+        key: torch.Tensor,
+        value: torch.Tensor,
+        kv_cache: torch.Tensor,
+        attn_metadata: FlashInferDiffKVMetadata,
+        output: torch.Tensor,
+        output_scale: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+        output_block_scale: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if output_scale is not None or output_block_scale is not None:
+            raise NotImplementedError(
+                "fused output quantization is not supported for FlashInferDiffKVImpl"
+            )
+        if attn_metadata is None:
+            return output.fill_(0)
+        assert self.flashinfer_supported
+        n = attn_metadata.num_actual_tokens
+        run_paged_prefill(
+            attn_metadata.prefill_wrapper,
+            query[:n],
+            kv_cache,
+            output[:n],
+            self.head_size,
+            TritonAttentionDiffKVBackend.head_size_v,
+        )
+        return output
+
+
+class FlashInferDiffKVBackend(TritonAttentionDiffKVBackend):
+    """Prefill child of ``TRITON_FLASHINFER_DIFFKV``; shares the Triton cache.
+
+    Per-layer eligibility is enforced by ``DiffKVPrefillRouting``.
+    """
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def get_name() -> str:
+        return "FLASHINFER_DIFFKV_PREFILL"
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def get_impl_cls() -> type[FlashInferDiffKVImpl]:
+        return FlashInferDiffKVImpl
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def get_builder_cls() -> type[FlashInferDiffKVMetadataBuilder]:  # type: ignore[override]
+        return FlashInferDiffKVMetadataBuilder
+
+    @classmethod
+    def supports_compute_capability(cls, capability: DeviceCapability) -> bool:
+        return capability.major == 12
+
+    @classmethod
+    def supports_mm_prefix(cls) -> bool:
+        return False
+
+
+class DiffKVPrefillRouting:
+    """FlashInfer (1) for whole batches containing a prefill, Triton (0) otherwise.
+
+    Decode-only and verification-only batches stay on Triton; decode rows in a
+    mixed batch run on FlashInfer with it.
+    """
+
+    capture_variant: ClassVar[int] = 0
+
+    def __init__(self, layer_names: list[str], vllm_config: VllmConfig) -> None:
+        layers = get_layers_from_vllm_config(
+            vllm_config,
+            AttentionLayerBase,  # type: ignore[type-abstract]
+            layer_names,
+        )
+        self.enabled = bool(layers) and all(
+            getattr(
+                getattr(layer.impl, "causal_impl", None), "flashinfer_supported", False
+            )
+            for layer in layers.values()
+        )
+        if not self.enabled:
+            logger.info_once(
+                "TRITON_FLASHINFER_DIFFKV: a layer in %s needs a feature the "
+                "FlashInfer prefill path does not cover; using Triton for it.",
+                layer_names[0] if layer_names else "<empty group>",
+            )
+        self.min_query_len = self.flashinfer_min_query_len(vllm_config)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def flashinfer_min_query_len(vllm_config: VllmConfig) -> int:
+        # Uniform (graph-capturable) batches are never wider than this.
+        return max(MIN_FLASHINFER_QUERY_LEN, max_decode_query_len(vllm_config))
+
+    def select(self, metadata: CommonAttentionMetadata) -> int:
+        return int(
+            self.enabled
+            and metadata.max_query_len > self.min_query_len
+            and not requires_mm_prefix(metadata)
+        )
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def get_cudagraph_support(
+        vllm_config: VllmConfig, kv_cache_spec: KVCacheSpec
+    ) -> AttentionCGSupport:
+        return AttentionCGSupport.UNIFORM_BATCH
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def variant_uses_mm_prefix(variant: int) -> bool:
+        return variant == 0
+
+
+_TritonFlashInferDiffKV = create_composite_attention_backend(
+    TritonAttentionDiffKVBackend,
+    FlashInferDiffKVBackend,
+    name="_TritonFlashInferDiffKV",
+    backend_name="TRITON_FLASHINFER_DIFFKV",
+    module=__name__,
+    routing_policy=DiffKVPrefillRouting,
+    device_major=12,
+)
+
+
+class TritonFlashInferDiffKVBackend(_TritonFlashInferDiffKV):  # type: ignore[valid-type,misc]
+    @classmethod
+    def set_head_size_v(cls, head_size_v: int) -> None:
+        TritonAttentionDiffKVBackend.set_head_size_v(head_size_v)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def is_supported_on_current_device(
+        cls,
+        head_size: int,
+        head_size_v: int,
+        has_sinks: bool,
+        sliding_window: int | None,
+        dtype: torch.dtype,
+        kv_cache_dtype: str,
+    ) -> bool:
+        """Auto-selection check; sm_90/sm_100 use FA DiffKV instead."""
+        if not envs.VLLM_DIFFKV_FLASHINFER_PREFILL:
+            return False
+        if not current_platform.is_cuda() or not has_flashinfer():
+            return False
+        capability = current_platform.get_device_capability()
+        if capability is None or not cls.supports_compute_capability(capability):
+            return False
+        return (
+            not has_sinks
+            and sliding_window is None
+            and (head_size, head_size_v) in _VALIDATED_HEAD_SIZES
+            and dtype in _SUPPORTED_DTYPES
+            and kv_cache_dtype in _SUPPORTED_KV_CACHE_DTYPES
+        )
